cards.hint: Think about authority for the national level.
options: how much power to allow the central government
whether to give states control over national laws
whether to require open sessions for all debates
whether to keep the Articles unchanged forever
cards.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government
cards.stem: What was a chief point at issue for delegates during the summer meetings?

cards.hint: Think about representation for each state.
options: how many representatives in Congress to allow each state
whether each state should have its own currency
whether delegates should meet in closed sessions
whether states should elect judges directly
cards.quote: how many representatives in Congress to allow each state
cards.stem: Which question about representation was among the chief issues?

cards.hint: Recall the city and hall where they gathered.
options: State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia
a meeting hall in New York
a state house in Boston
a courthouse in Charleston
cards.quote: convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation
cards.stem: Where did the Federal Convention meet to begin its work?

cards.hint: Recall whether the work was done openly or not.
options: in secret
in public sessions
in open town meetings
by mail correspondence
cards.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787
cards.stem: How was the drafting carried out by delegates that summer?
